feynrl_paper.title: Trust the Batch, On- or Off-Policy: Adaptive Policy Optimization for RL Post-Training (Fakoor, Aubry, Stranges, Smola)
feynrl_paper.anchor_convention: feynrl:§N (section), feynrl:eqN (equation number as printed), feynrl:pN (pdf page), feynrl:figN / feynrl:tableN
feynrl_paper.note: Bundle sha256 19b66e97… (see discovered.json). Equation, section, figure and page numbers were checked against the page images for pages 2-9: Eqs. 1-13, Table 1, Figs. 1-4. Page 1 (abstract), appendices A-E (Tables 2-7, Figs. 5-9) are not in the image set; quotes anchored at feynrl:table7 / feynrl:§C / feynrl:§D / feynrl:abstract come from the arXiv abstract/HTML page via WebFetch and carry basis 'inference' in the KPs. Introduces no new algorithm: the paper adopts P3O (Fakoor, Chaudhari, Smola 2019, arXiv:1905.01756) for large-model post-training.

feynrl_repo.title: FeynRL: RL post-training library (local clone; code behind the paper; atlas thread atlas/repos/feynrl)

feynrl_repo.anchor_convention: algs/P3O/p3o.py:L107-L135 (repo-relative path, 1-based inclusive line range); checked by atlas/tools/check_anchors.py
feynrl_repo.note: Status 'implemented' anchors point at algs/P3O/p3o.py (calculate_ess, compute_policy_loss), algs/GRPO/grpo.py and algs/CISPO/cispo.py (the fixed-clip contrasts) and core/rl_engines.py (use_decoupled_loss wiring). p3o_readme.note: The implementation's own account of the loss (L13-L48), the dual-role table (L50-L57), the algorithm box (L59-L93) and the notes on sync/async equivalence, global token normalization and the unused clip bounds (L96-L103).

rl_readme.title: algs/RL/README.md: RL Common (common.py)
rl_readme.note: Shared base class: proximal snapshot (used by PPO/GRPO/CISPO in overlap mode, not by P3O, L15-L18) and the variance-reduced KL estimator (L20-L29) that implements the KL term of Eq. 12.
